purpose: Document first-party local registry/viewer evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official CG BhuNaksha client/config and JavaScript were reviewed. Selectors returned district 44 Raipur, tehsil 07 Raipur, RI 03 रायपुर-1-रायपुरा, and revenue village 221 रायपुरा (hasData=true). getVVVVExtentGeoref returned bounds x=916697..919933, y=1022840..1026261 with request srs=0 and no declared CRS; it cannot be compared safely with the WUP locator. Viewer getPlotAtXY returns interactive plot info and its OP=4 handler can return plot data without a safe field allowlist, so neither was queried. WMS layers render maps and do not provide full vector parcel geometry. Municipal map service reviewed exposes boundaries/wards; property-tax searches require property/owner identifiers and were not used. Whether this locator lies in revenue village Raipura or another adjacent mapped area; whether any anonymous vector polygon service exists for the exact point.
